title: Harbor District Ferry Service | Passenger-count pilot
titleZh: 港區渡輪服務｜乘客人數統計試行
passage:
Beginning June 3, the West Pier and Market Pier crews will count passengers who cannot board because a ferry is full. This is a planning trial, not a fare check. Do not record names, and do not include riders who choose to wait for a later ferry while there is still room on the current one. The planner will use the figures to distinguish a lack of seats from a lack of information about departures.

The handheld counter sends a confirmed total when the supervisor closes a departure on the device. A departure closed on a spare counter is treated like any other in the planner’s report. If the primary counter fails before closing, note its visible tally on paper and resume from that number on the spare. The daily paper form has two boxes: “unsent totals” and “equipment notes.” Entries in the first box are added to device totals. Write a short description under equipment notes whenever a device is swapped.

Both piers will also record whether the street entrance displayed the correct departure during boarding. Keep a headcount in the report but tag the run for separate analysis if that display was wrong at any point while passengers were boarding. An error seen only at another location or outside that time does not need the tag. A tagged run will not be used to estimate the effect of adding another ferry until the planner reviews the sign discrepancy. A blank street-entrance sign is handled differently: if crew members read the correct departure aloud at the street entrance throughout boarding, no tag is needed.

The June 17 memo will report headcounts by departure but will not recommend an additional ferry. Only runs suitable for the capacity analysis count toward the minimum needed for that recommendation. If a pier falls short, its supervisor should extend the trial there rather than extending both schedules. This decision is made after the planner reviews any tagged runs.
passageZh:
自 6 月 3 日起，西碼頭與市場碼頭的工作人員會統計因渡輪客滿而無法登船的人數。這是為了規劃服務而試行，並非查票。不要記錄姓名；若當班船還有空位，但乘客自行選擇等下一班，也不要計入。規劃人員將用這些數字區分座位不足與乘客沒有得到足夠的班次資訊。

主管在手持計數器上結束該班次的登船紀錄時，計數器就會傳送確認後的總數。規劃人員的報表對用備用計數器結束登船紀錄的班次，會與其他班次同等處理。若主計數器在結束登船紀錄前故障，請把畫面上可見的數字記在紙上，然後在備用計數器從該數字繼續計數。每日紙本表單有兩個欄位：「尚未傳送的總數」與「設備備註」；第一欄的數字會加到裝置傳送的總數上。只要更換過設備，就要在設備備註欄簡短說明。

兩座碼頭也會記錄登船期間臨街入口是否顯示正確的班次。若登船期間該看板曾顯示錯誤，須把人數保留在報表中，但要標記該班次以便另行分析。若錯誤只出現在其他位置，或只發生在登船期間以外，就不需要標記。在規劃人員檢視看板資訊不符的情況前，有標記的班次不納入增開一班渡輪的效果估算。臨街入口的看板沒有顯示任何資訊時，處理方式不同：若工作人員在整段登船期間都在臨街入口口頭告知正確班次，就不需要標記。

6 月 17 日的備忘錄會列出各班次的人數，但不會建議增開渡輪。只有適合拿來分析運量的班次，才會列入提出該建議所需的最低班次數。若某座碼頭的班次數不足，該碼頭的主管應延長當地的試行，而不是一併延長兩座碼頭的試行。要等規劃人員檢視完所有有標記的班次後，才做這項決定。
